attributes.note: a name that is a key by C2-I-030; any other name is dropped and reported

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.note: read on the task box; on an admonition `aside` it is generated and not kept; elsewhere a key

attributes.name: class
attributes.note: split at ASCII whitespace; a class a convention reads is not kept; a value that leaves no class gives no `classes` (C2-A-058)

attributes.name: data-carve-
attributes.note: the 19 reserved names of C2-H-115 only

attributes.name: dir
attributes.note: `ltr`, `rtl` or `auto` in any ASCII letter case, kept in lower case; another value is dropped and reported

attributes.name: style
attributes.note: exact alignment declarations are read (C2-M-040, C2-M-075), and the declarations of a `col` style (C2-M-041)

conventions.name: admonition
conventions.test: first class `admonition`, second class a kind of C2-H-154

conventions.name: admonition-title
conventions.test: class exactly `admonition-title`, first block of a div, an admonition or a footnote section (C2-M-061)

conventions.name: ext
conventions.test: first class `ext-NAME`, where NAME is an inline extension name (C2-I-094)

conventions.name: math
conventions.test: classes `math inline` or `math display`, text between `\(` and `\)` or `\[` and `\]`

conventions.name: mention
conventions.test: first class `mention`, one `strong` child whose text starts with the sigil

conventions.name: tag
conventions.test: first class `tag`, one `strong` child whose text starts with `#`

codes.reports: an attribute that the tree does not keep: an event handler, a name that is no key, an invalid `dir`, a wrapper or section attribute, an unread attribute of `code` or of a task box, an ordered start out of range, an `align` or `valign` beside a declaration of its axis, a `col` style that gives no width or holds another declaration, a cell `scope`, `align` or `valign` outside its set, an attribute of a `figure` that the captioned block replaces, the attributes of a body that the head move leaves empty
a destination that fails the deny list; the link is its text and the image its alternative text

an element or comment given nothing, with its content: the head, the doctype, the treatment `drop`, and with `rawHtml` off every comment, the treatment `raw` and every `data-carve-raw` span; a further task box or table caption, a ranged comment with no text
an element without a counterpart read as a div, a span or its children; a block element in inline content; a section without a heading; MathML without TeX

content dropped or changed so that the tree is valid or a list table can hold it: a non-item child of a list, a foreign child of a table or a description list, a second head or foot of a table, a data cell of the table head, a clamped row span, the range of a ranged comment read as a point, an empty node that held attributes, a ruby base without annotation, a footnote item with no `id` or an empty key; in a list table, a dropped row span or the boundary between two bodies
whitespace removed or a line break turned into a space; no visible text changes

losses.name: data-carve-abbreviations
losses.comes_back: each `<abbr>` is a span with the key `abbr`; the definitions are gone

losses.name: data-carve-autolink
losses.comes_back: a link whose text is its target

losses.name: data-carve-caption-number
losses.comes_back: the number as text in the caption

losses.name: data-carve-div
losses.comes_back: nothing: a plain div reads as a div

losses.name: data-carve-explicit-id
losses.comes_back: nothing: every id reads as authored

losses.name: data-carve-footnote-label
losses.comes_back: the key from the note id, the footnote number

losses.name: data-carve-generated-id
losses.comes_back: the generated id as an authored `attrs.id`

losses.name: data-carve-inline-footnote
losses.comes_back: a footnote reference and a footnote definition

losses.name: data-carve-line-block
losses.comes_back: a div with class `line-block` of paragraphs with hard breaks

losses.name: data-carve-ref
losses.comes_back: an inline link or image with its `href`, `src` and `title`; no definition is rebuilt

losses.name: data-carve-source-level
losses.comes_back: a heading at its shifted level

losses.name: data-carve-tight
losses.comes_back: spacing by C2-M-033: a tight list whose item holds more than one block reads as loose

losses.name: data-carve-xref
losses.comes_back: a link to `#ID` whose text is the generated text
